🧭 COUNTY-CARVED STATE MAZES

MD · DE · NJ · NY · Montréal — each maze is carved from the real state outline and real county lines (U.S. Census Bureau boundary data). Crossing between counties is only possible at one or two real shared-border “doorways” per pair, so the county map itself shapes the path.

How to play: Trace a single path from START to FINISH without crossing any walls. Bold lines are real county/state borders; thin lines are maze walls. The Montréal/Québec maze uses a maple-leaf silhouette as a stand-in shape, since no county-equivalent boundary data was available for that region. Solutions are at the end if you get stuck.
